# Self-Hosted Report Assets

Local copies bundled so the v4.5 Results Report, Interactive Explorer, and Technical Paper render offline and on GitHub Pages without external CDN requests.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `echarts.min.js` | `echarts@5.5.1/dist/echarts.min.js` | Apache-2.0 |
| `fonts/ibm-plex-sans-{400,500,600}.woff2` | `@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans@5.0.20` (latin subset) | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `fonts/ibm-plex-mono-400.woff2` | `@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono@5.0.13` (latin subset) | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `fonts/source-serif-4-wght{,-italic}.woff2` | `@fontsource-variable/source-serif-4@5.0.19` (latin subset) | SIL OFL 1.1 |
